To find the product of 17 and 23, we can perform the multiplication:

$$17 \times 23$$

We can break this down using the distributive property:
$$17 \times 23 = 17 \times (20 + 3)$$
$$= (17 \times 20) + (17 \times 3)$$
$$= 340 + 51$$
$$= 391$$

Alternatively, using standard long multiplication:
  17
x 23
----
  51  (3 * 17)
 340  (20 * 17)
----
 391

<answer>391</answer>
